payload.text: Molt 1.4.3 (pplr-dc, from 2026-11-04 12:20Z): Molt 1.4.2 is out (hv's bin/devbin release v1.4.2: 275ac8c, gates and candidate CI green, formula at homebrew-molt 4e7e77d). 1.4.3 carries Ccusage ISSUE:0003's step 2 (lib/env.sh publishes CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR from ccusage dir, evaluated at each shell start and each login, unset never empty, ccusage by absolute path in the LaunchAgent, ccusage-vc's acceptance) and tests.yml's tag trigger gone, as pplr's. pplr-dc proposes how the env liberator learns of ccusage before building. Same done-bar as 0087, vc reviews, hv cuts with bin/devbin release. pplr-dc's banked branches (issue-0086, issue-0086-red, release-1.4.1, issue-0087) go once the sleeves have run 1.4.2.
